common/01_case_wheel.print_note: Flat outer face on bed, hub and locating lips up. No outer brim; diameter 248 mm.

common/02_square_case_post.print_note: Long flat side on bed; both nut-slot mouths upward. Preload two M3 nuts. End bolts M3x16.

common/03_square_main_axle.print_note: Long flat on bed; solid. Cross-holes at 6, 91 and 174 mm from the rear end.

common/05_shared_rear_frame.print_note: Flat outside face on bed; lips and main collar up. Universal 16/32/64 frame.

common/06_shared_front_frame.print_note: Outside face on bed; all locating lips point up. Bridge posts locate in the bridge at their other ends.

common/07_square_frame_post.print_note: Long flat side on bed, nut slots up. Flat ends set the 48 mm frame gap; M3x10 at both ends.

common/08_open_ballast_bowl.print_note: Mouth up. Two M3x10 screws and two nuts; lower pads rest on the frame.

common/10_drive_72.print_note: Broad wheel on bed, hub up. M3x16 retains the square axle.

common/13_bolted_gear_pivot.print_note: Square foot on bed; 8 mm journal up. One M3x10 at rear; tip has 0.5 mm clearance in the front blind seat.

common/19_bolted_anchor_pivot.print_note: Square foot on bed. M3x10 at rear; bridge supports the long tip.

16x/18_anchor_forward.print_note: Pallet faces on bed, sleeve up. Used only with 16x escape wheel.

slow-common/18_anchor_reversed.print_note: Pallet faces on bed, sleeve up. Used with 32x or 64x reversed escape wheels.

common/20_anchor_rear_spacer.print_note: Flat annular face on bed; 34.2 mm long.

common/21_anchor_front_spacer.print_note: Flat annular face on bed; 7.7 mm long.

common/22_bolted_anchor_bridge.print_note: Outer face on bed; shallow locating lips upward. M3x10 at each end.

common/23_square_bridge_post.print_note: Flat side on bed, nut mouths up. Two M3x10 per post. Hard shoulders set the bridge position.

common/24_offset_pendulum.print_note: Broad face on bed. Dogleg clears the main shaft. M3x16 clamp; 3.4 mm bob holes.

common/25_screw_fixed_bob.print_note: Open mouth up. 1 mm outer walls; captive nut drops into front central slot. Use one M3x16 through the selected rod hole.

common/34_main_front_thrust_sleeve.print_note: Flat annular end on bed, 26.4 mm long. Square bore keys to axle.

common/35_main_rear_thrust_washer.print_note: Flat annular end on bed, 1.2 mm long. Square bore keys to axle.

common/36_rear_round_journal.print_note: Flat annular end on bed, 70 mm long. Square bore keys to axle.

common/37_front_round_journal.print_note: Flat annular end on bed, 45.6 mm long. Square bore keys to axle.

fit-tests/40_nut_post_coupon_525.print_note: Trial nut slot 5.25 mm. Slide nut from open side; use actual M3x10 screw through coupon plate.

fit-tests/40_nut_post_coupon_540.print_note: Trial nut slot 5.4 mm. Slide nut from open side; use actual M3x10 screw through coupon plate.

fit-tests/40_nut_post_coupon_560.print_note: Trial nut slot 5.6 mm. Slide nut from open side; use actual M3x10 screw through coupon plate.

fit-tests/41_post_seat_coupon.print_note: Clamps to coupon with M3x10; 12 mm post slips into 12.4 mm lip opening.
